review_objections: Alibaba: Transliteration is inconsistent/incorrect: 'पोस्टग्रेSQL' mixes Devanagari and Latin script. It should be 'पोस्टग्रेस्क्वल' or 'पोस्टग्रेSQL' (all Latin) or 'पोस्टग्रेस्क्वल' (all Devanagari). Also, while it is a database, the topic 'backend' is acceptable, but the transliteration error is the primary issue.
